purpose: Generated seamless albedo approximations based on user product sample photos; not manufacturer-calibrated official maps.

prompts.oak: Create a production-ready seamless tileable albedo texture for a 3D architectural material, square 1024x1024. Use attached laminate photograph as color and woodgrain reference (ROYCE Sense SE-710 Oak Aya): muted medium grey-brown oak, sophisticated natural long grain, a few small elongated knots, subtle tonal streaks, matte. Orthographic flat surface, evenly lit pure base color, no baked highlights or shadows. Continuous natural vertical oak grain across the full square, no board boundaries or seams; 3D geometry will define separate 180mm planks. Match the central oak sample in the reference, not the surrounding panels. Remove all labels, text, logos, handle openings, stickers, background, red circles. No perspective, no decorative frame. Seamless in both axes. Save the generated texture as an asset.
prompts.porcelain: Create a production-ready seamless tileable albedo material texture for a 3D architectural porcelain tile, square 1024x1024. Match attached reference sample LAPARET Smart Gris matte structured porcelain: neutral medium cool grey stone-concrete, subtle mineral mottling and fine natural granular pores, quiet restrained surface, no prominent veins. Take color and fine surface character from the flat sample in the photograph, do not reproduce the label. Flat orthographic evenly lit base-color map, no lighting gradient, no baked shadows or specular highlights. Edge-to-edge single continuous stone surface; no grout lines or tile borders (600x600mm tile geometry and grout are created separately). Remove all letters, logos, QR codes, stickers, red circles, product text and showroom background. Seamless tiling in both directions. Realistic subtle high-frequency surface detail.
